question: Which of the following Carnatic instruments is performed by Rajna Swaminathan?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Mridangam**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajna Swaminathan

 
 
• **Rajna Swaminathan**, who is based in Maryland, U.S., also took up Carnatic **vocal and Bharatanatyam** classes, but chose to **specialise in the mridangam. **
 
• Rajna is born into a musical family — her late mother was a singer and her **father plays the mridangam.**
 
• The mridangam is a percussion instrument of ancient origin.
 
• One of the most **ancient drums of India, the mridangam, **which literally means **'body of clay,' **originated in **South India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adb42a12a1b280b99303fb9a85494f76b3a9426fc9ec6f935fdb270080c523fc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The violin**, also known as a** fiddle,** is a **wooden chordophone **in the violin family.
 
• Most violins have a** hollow wooden body.****​ **
 
• The flute is **a family of classical music instrument in the woodwind group**.
 
• **The veena** comprises** various chordophone** instruments from the Indian subcontinent.
